title: The Wing Nut That Flips Itself in Space
summary: A translation of the same day's science episode. In nineteen eighty-five, aboard the Salyut 7 station, cosmonaut Vladimir Dzhanibekov watched a spinning wing nut flip over on its own at regular intervals. The episode explains the intermediate axis theorem behind this: rotation about an object's longest and shortest axes is stable, but rotation about the middle axis is unstable.
